name: Shirakawa (Gifu, Japan, village)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shirakawa village emblem in purple: a ring open at the lower hoist enclosing a stylised mountain of stacked strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Shirakawa, a village in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1963.

features.role: Shirakawa village emblem — a ring open at the lower hoist enclosing a stylised mountain of stacked strokes
